beats.event: Lives alone in Glasgow; two bottles of vodka every weekend
Calls herself 'completely fine'; mocked by coworkers
Wednesday-night calls with a cruel, controlling 'mother'
Wins raffle tickets to see singer Johnnie Lomond
Fixates on Johnnie as her destined future husband
Begins grooming herself: haircut, wax, new clothes
With coworker Raymond she saves elderly Sammy on the street
A warm friendship grows through Sammy's family
At the concert she is invisible; Johnnie moons the crowd
Dry ice triggers memories of a childhood house fire
Three-day drinking binge; assembles suicide materials
Raymond finds her and helps her recover
Sees GP; referred to a mental-health counselor
Returns to work; welcomed warmly by colleagues
With support, ends contact with 'her mother'
Truth surfaces: at 10 her mother set the fire to kill them
Her little sister Marianne died in that fire
'Eleanor Oliphant' is a protective new legal name
The mother phone calls were her own invention; she moves on
